answer: What survives to the basalt is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The knoll is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the pearl. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, revoked by a single upheld challenge, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
